Official document (PDF) · Meeting record S/PV.2714

Resolution 589 (1986) of 10 October 1986

The Security Council, Having considered the question of the recommendation for the appointment of the Secretary-General of the United Nations, Recommends to the General Assembly that Mr. Javier Perez de Cuellar be appointed Secretary-General of the United Nations for a second term of office from 1 January 1987 te 31 December 1991.

Adopted unanimously at the 2714th (closed) meeting
